lemma.erratum: ali 'wave; grey hair' mapped to *Heh₃l- 'bend, elbow' + *pelH- 'pale, grey'
lemma.note: cq1 w10 r4 (DMHP Agathangelos word 23691 aleacʻn 'waves'). Martirosyan EDAIL s.v. ali-kʻ 1/2, pp. 14-15 (file p0028-p0029): waves and grey hair from *pel- 'grey' (Gr. πολιός); Kaikki Old Armenian ալի (wave) likewise. *Heh₃l- belongs only to the rare homograph ali 'axle, millstone' (J̌ahukyan apud Kaikki), not attested in the DMHP tokens of this lemma.
cq1 w10 r4; as ali (Martirosyan EDAIL pp. 14-15, file p0028-p0029).

lemma.erratum: bov 'furnace, crucible' mapped to *bʰo (emphatic particle) by key collision
lemma.note: cq1 w10 r48 (DMHP Agathangelos word 51127 i bovs pʻorjowtʻean 'in the crucible of trial'). Kaikki Old Armenian բով 'furnace, crucible': only Ačaṙyan's old *bʰō-/*bʰow- (*bʰeh₁- 'warm'); not the particle. Unmapped rather than asserting the disputed root.

lemma.erratum: elkʻ 'exit, issue' mapped to *h₁ésti 'be' through the infinitive el of em
lemma.note: cq1 w10 r28 obs2 (DMHP Lazar word 21943 elkʻ gorcoyn 'the outcome of the work'). Kaikki Old Armenian ել noun 'egress, departure, exit', from the root of ելանեմ; the form-of em link is a homograph. The aorist elicʻ 'filled' tokens go to lnowm by the cq1_xcl elic-filled rule.

cq1 formula witness scan item 11 (DMHP Eznik word 15023 towičʻ tʻagaworowtʻeancʻ 'giver of kingdoms'): agent noun in -ičʻ on tow-, the aorist stem of tam 'give' (*deh₃-); DMHP lemmatised it as tiw 'day' (*dyḗws).

cq1 w10 r121 (DMHP Lazar word 60637 y-akanǰs 'into the ears'). Martirosyan EDAIL s.v. akanǰ, pp. 21-22 (file p0035-p0036): originally the dual of unkn 'ear' (*h₂ous-), ǰ after ačʻ 'eyes' (Meillet, HAB); a Kartvelian alternative is noted there. Kept on the ear lexeme as another formation.
